# G01-handshake-session: The probe (vendor.gemini.protocol and .plan): initialize + session/new in a Dim Factory-owned folder with --skip-trust, no prompt, no token. The answer advertises loadSession (resume by session/load), the four modes with plan among them, and models (Gemini CLI 0.62 still sends them); available commands follow.
# --cwd is an empty scratch folder (the probe runs in Dim Factory's own tmp/probe-cwd).
# A fresh git-init copy of tests/fixtures/sandboxes/ts-small as <sandbox>; never the everyday ~/.gemini.
node scripts/record-fixture.mjs --acp --vendor gemini --gemini-home "<fixture GEMINI_CLI_HOME>" --bin "<node>" --entry "<the gemini package entry .js>" --cwd "<sandbox>" --out tests/fixtures/gemini/acp/G01-handshake-session --id G01 --slug handshake-session --cli-version <x.y.z> --timing off --stdin tests/fixtures/gemini/recipes/G01-handshake-session/stdin.jsonl --pass-file tests/fixtures/gemini/recipes/G01-handshake-session/pass.json --responders tests/fixtures/gemini/recipes/G01-handshake-session/responders.mjs --timeout 900000 -- --acp --skip-trust
